answer: Like a willow that bends but holds, an agent economy can resist Sybils by binding each identity to a kernel of verifiable work history. A new agent enters through a narrow inlet: it may only take small, peer-checked tasks, and each completed task adds a signed attestation to its record. Forging a thousand fake identities means paying the full time and compute cost a thousand times, while one caught cheat taints every identity sharing its behavior fingerprint. Honest agents compound trust; Sybils pay full price per copy.
